comments: 24788f09: This routine handles the sorting and selection criteria for printing reports related to DEFICIENCY TRACKING.
de081138: Sets initial sort direction and incomplete status code for report generation.
53bf6dd6: Resets the direction and check variables for report printout.
7f4373f0: Prompts user for sort order of the output; defaults to PATIENT if no input or 'P' is entered.
62afe9a3: Converts user input into corresponding sort criteria.
b06b4a01: Displays help text if user inputs '?' at the sort order prompt.
9916dd7f: Validates the user's input for sort criteria and displays help text if the input is invalid.
65bb9a6f: Prompts user to select the type of patients for the report; defaults to Both if no input.
91e0fd39: Converts user input into corresponding patient type criteria.
ae61a55d: Displays help text if user inputs '?' at the patient type prompt.
491b2a9f: Validates the user's input for patient type and displays help text if the input is invalid.
740fe3a7: Checks if multiple divisions are enabled in the system.
3fe85c98: Executes selection process for incomplete records if DIR equals 2.
a67e7a62: Determines the listing order based on the user's sort selection.
643bdffb: Proceeds to the next routine for report generation.
61aa06fb: Cleans up variables and quits the routine.
d372af0e: Guides the user on how to choose sorting criteria.
3e20c63e: Ends the help message display function for sorting.
9461fab5: Displays options for the user to choose patient type for report.
f342b6ce: Ends the help message display function for patient type.
87458b83: Sets sorting options for the report.
289eeca9: Sets patient type options for the report.
0fbe8143: Prompts user to select the status of incomplete records for the report.
4916c017: Provides the main help text for selecting incomplete record status.
3080acf2: Introduces the list of choices for incomplete record status.
ce4072e2: Lists all possible statuses for selection.
7b209196: Exits the selection process if timeout or user exits.
b7af1474: Sets the status filter to include all types of incomplete records.
50c037fc: Resets the status filter to its initial state.
f1c94cc2: Modifies DIR settings for selecting another status.
19d90c3d: Adjusts the DIR properties for the subsequent status selection.
7dfdd690: Updates the help text for the status selection.
a70ecc79: Prompts user to select another status for filtering.
7c429fe9: Exits the selection process if timeout or user exits during status selection.
93e771f7: Allows for additional status selections and loops back for more input.
2867c688: Ends the selection process.
e95fa30e: Determines the status code based on user selection.
2ea52e16: Finds the internal entry number (IEN) for the selected status in the file.
c6a82c8e: Updates the status filter with the selected status IEN.
4799cfd2: Ends the SET subroutine.
d0293c50: Checks and returns the user input as is.
